title: Dairy Farming Guide
excerpt: Dairy farming is a profitable and reliable agricultural business that provides daily income through consistent milk production. This guide highlights the best cow breeds, feeding methods, shed design, health care, and milk processing techniques needed to run a modern and efficient dairy farm. Whether starting small or planning commercial expansion, these practical insights will help you build a sustainable and high-yield dairy operation.
